title: Robot Wizard and Lunar Cats
description: A robotic figure wearing a tattered purple coat and brass helmet stands on a broken stone platform, holding a glowing purple staff in one hand while waving with the other. Three cats sit beside him: a grey cat, a black cat, and an orange cat with a blue scarf, all facing forward under a giant cracked moon with a sleeping face set inside a massive metallic gear against a starry purple sky with lightning.
prompt: A lone robot wizard with a cracked brass helmet, glowing yellow eyes, and a tattered magenta coat stands on the edge of a broken stone platform floating in space. He holds a tall staff topped with a glowing purple orb and raises his other hand in a wave. Beside him sit three cats: a grey tabby, a black cat, and an orange cat wearing a blue scarf. Behind them looms a massive cracked celestial face of a sleeping moon with one red eye, framed inside an enormous broken metallic gear. Dramatic purple starry sky with lightning bolts, stylized illustrative style with strong outlines and vibrant colors.
